meta.title: DM Artefact Meta-Metamodel
meta.subtitle: The typed links between the artefact models: a business glossary term flows through the conceptual and logical data models to the dictionary, business rules and transformations; a critical data element has data quality expectations that group its dimensions and metrics; and a dataset carries its lineage (the chain of transformations) and its provenance (the broader record of origin).

layers.name: Business / semantic
layers.desc: Shared meaning: glossary terms, business domains and the reference values data is drawn from.

layers.name: Conceptual model
layers.desc: The business things and how they relate, independent of technology.

layers.name: Logical model
layers.desc: Entities and their attributes, structured but not yet physical.

layers.name: Data element / physical
layers.desc: The dictionary fields, the datasets they sit in, and the critical ones.

layers.name: Data quality
layers.desc: The quality expected of a critical data element: expectations grouping the dimensions and metrics it is held to.

layers.name: Rules
layers.desc: Business rules that govern allowed values, derivations and constraints.

layers.name: Lineage and provenance
layers.desc: The data lineage (the chain of transformations that moves and derives the data) and the data provenance (the broader record of origin: who or what, from what, and when).

layers.name: Governance
layers.desc: Classification and stewardship roles that sit across every artefact.

artefacts.name: Business glossary term
artefacts.desc: An agreed business term with a definition, synonyms and relationships.

artefacts.name: Business domain
artefacts.desc: A business area that groups datasets and terms.

artefacts.name: Reference / code list
artefacts.desc: Controlled values and code lists that make data interpretable and joinable. Ties to M8.

artefacts.name: Conceptual entity
artefacts.desc: A business thing in the conceptual data model.

artefacts.name: Logical entity / attribute
artefacts.desc: An entity and its attributes in the logical data model.

artefacts.name: Data element
artefacts.desc: A field in the data dictionary: datatype, format, allowed values, classification, PII.

artefacts.name: Critical data element
artefacts.desc: A data element the business depends on, so quality expectations are set and measured against it.

artefacts.name: Dataset
artefacts.desc: A nominated dataset, catalogued with its metadata.

artefacts.name: Data quality expectation
artefacts.desc: The quality expected of a critical data element: a grouping of the dimensions and metrics it is held to. In MFPI, the dimension targets and gates set for the dataset.

artefacts.name: Data quality dimension
artefacts.desc: A dimension of quality. In MFPI, MQD-01 to MQD-07: sufficiency, interpretability, evidential support, consistency, currency, traceability, conformance.

artefacts.name: Data quality metric
artefacts.desc: A measure and threshold that scores a dimension: numerator over denominator (tests passed over tests expected) against a target.

artefacts.name: Business rule
artefacts.desc: A rule that governs allowed values, derivations or constraints on a data element. No dedicated viewer yet.

artefacts.name: Data lineage
artefacts.desc: The end-to-end flow of a dataset's data from source to target, composed of the transformations along the way.

artefacts.name: Data transformation
artefacts.desc: A single step that transforms, derives or moves data, implementing a business rule. Transformations chain together to form the lineage.

artefacts.name: Data provenance
artefacts.desc: The record of origin and history: who or what produced the data, from what, and when. Broader than data-flow lineage. PROV-O: entities, activities, agents. Ties to M10.

artefacts.name: Classification / sensitivity
artefacts.desc: The sensitivity label and CIA handling of a data element. Ties to M5.

artefacts.name: Role (RACI)
artefacts.desc: The accountable and responsible roles that steward each artefact.
